## b39674306606

**Reproduced defect A1; source left unchanged.** Generator SHA-256 from the audit
assignment is `ff480f1799acf6aa5c1c83c3c566ba3868a05bbcd947c07737262e348947649a`.

The exact-axis contract silently coerces invalid scalar types. With ordinary
generation, `grid_h=10.9` and `grid_h="10"` both become 10,
`pair_count=True` becomes 1, and `singleton_size="4"` becomes 4. These are
accepted rather than rejected, so typos and booleans can masquerade as valid
exact overrides.

The strict validator also accepts a padded 15×17 grid even though the advertised
domains are height 10..14 and width 12..16. Both `self_check` and
`strict_canonical_like` return `[]`, and `observe_axes` reports the out-of-range
dimensions. This is a validator/override-contract defect in an input that the
validator itself admits; it is not evidence that the ordinary sampler emits the
padded case.

Reproducer: `checks/audit/b39674306606/reproduce_contract_holes.py`.
Structured output: `checks/audit/b39674306606/reproduction.json`.
The target's existing task tests still pass 9/9 at
`checks/audit/b39674306606-task-tests/result.json`; that clean suite does not
cover these cases.
